# scaffolding_node (Resource)

Proxmox VE node-level configuration (description, wake-on-LAN, ACME registrations, DNS, and timezone).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The PVE node name (e.g. `pve1`).

### Optional

- `acme_domain` (Attributes List) ACME domains to register with the PVE ACME account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--acme_domain))
- `description` (String) Free-form description shown in the PVE web UI.
- `dns1` (String) Primary DNS server.
- `dns2` (String) Secondary DNS server.
- `dns3` (String) Tertiary DNS server.
- `dns_search` (String) Search domain appended to short hostnames for DNS lookups.
- `startall_onboot_delay` (Number) Delay in seconds before auto-starting any VMs on cluster boot.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone name (e.g. `Europe/Berlin`). PVE accepts any value `timedatectl list-timezones` accepts; the provider does not maintain a whitelist.
- `wakeonlan` (String) MAC address to send a Wake-on-LAN packet to on cluster start (colon-separated, e.g. `AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF`).

### Read-Only

- `digest` (String) Opaque digest returned by PVE; populated after each read and passed back on update for optimistic concurrency.

<a id="nestedatt--acme_domain"></a>
### Nested Schema for `acme_domain`

Required:

- `domain` (String) Fully qualified domain name to register.

Optional:

- `alias` (List of String) Optional alias names registered for the same certificate.
